history state belongs to the current shell

transformations.bash-c: Run the unchanged command text as a Bash command. This preserves Bash syntax such as here-strings; shlex quoting passes it as one -c argument.
transformations.cd-dot-and: Prefix a stateless command with `cd . &&`; its working directory is unchanged.
transformations.command-prefix: Prefix a single simple command with Bash's `command` builtin.
transformations.env-bash-c: Use env to launch the same Bash -c command with unchanged command text. env adds no assignments, so Bash receives the same string and inherited environment.
transformations.true-semi: Prefix with `true;`; the extra command succeeds before the original command.
